repos.name: illumination
repos.description: Manages light source, lens system, and illumination optics for the lithography scanner. Controls laser power, numerical aperture, and beam conditioning.

repos.name: scan_manager
repos.description: Controls wafer stage motion, scan sequencing, and real-time position feedback. Responsible for precise XYZ positioning during slit scans.

repos.name: expose_sequence
repos.description: Manages exposure sequences, dose control, and shot coordination for each wafer field. Triggers exposures and monitors cumulative dose per shot.

demo.feature_request: Add adaptive dose correction based on real-time stage position feedback during scan
